zh: adj. 正方形的，四方形的
en: an open area with buildings around it, often in the centre of a town
ex: a famous square

zh: 王宫，（官位极高者的）府邸；住在王宫里的人，王室（the Palace）；大厦，豪宅
en: a very large building where a king, queen or president lives
ex: a famous palace

zh: n. （石或金属做的动物或人的）雕像
en: a model that looks like a person or animal, usually made from stone or metal
ex: a famous statue

zh: 银行；储蓄罐；库存，库；河岸；斜坡；云团，雾团；一排，一组；庄家的赌本；（泥）滩，沙洲
en: an organisation or place where you can borrow money, save money, etc.
ex: The chemist is next to the bank.

zh: 化学家；<英>药剂师；<英>药店，药房
en: a shop where you can buy medicines, make-up and products used for washing yourself
ex: You buy medicine at a chemist.

zh: 图书馆，藏书楼；（书、激光唱片等的）私人收藏；书房，书斋；文库，系列丛书（激光唱片集，成套录像等）；软件库
en: a room or building that contains a collection of books and other written material that you can read or borrow
ex: You read books in a library.

zh: 博物馆
en: a building where you can look at important objects connected with art, history, or science
ex: You look at interesting things in a museum.

zh: n. 公园
en: a large area of grass and trees in a city or town, where people can walk and enjoy themselves
ex: You play football in a park.

zh: 邮局；The Post Office（首字母大写，常与 the 连用）指国家邮政机构，在美国亦指美国邮政局
en: a place where stamps are sold and from where letters and parcels are sent
ex: You send letters in a post office.

zh: n. 餐馆，饭店
en: a place where you can buy and eat a meal
ex: You eat lunch or dinner in a restaurant.

zh: 超级市场，超市
en: a large shop that sells food, drink, products for the home, etc.
ex: You buy milk in a supermarket.

zh: 火车站：火车停靠、供乘客上下车（或装卸货物）的地方。
en: a building and the surrounding area where trains stop for people to get on and off
ex: You get on a train at a train station.

zh: 在（或向）……的后面；落后于；是……背后的原因；支持；（……的外表）之下；成为（某人的）过去；低于；在……死后
en: at or to the back of someone or something
ex: The chemist's is behind the bank.

zh: prep. （空间上）在……中间
en: in the space that separates two people, places, or things
ex: The restaurant is between the post office and the park.

zh: 在……的前部或附近
en: close to the front part of something
ex: The museum is in front of the library.

zh: used when describing two people or things that are very close to each other with nothing between them
en: used when describing two people or things that are very close to each other with nothing between them
ex: The restaurant is next to the park.

zh: 在……的拐角处：表示某物或某人位于某个街角的交叉口处。
en: at a point where two lines, surfaces, roads etc. meet
ex: The post office is on the corner of Green Street and High Street.

zh: 完全相反的，截然不同的；相反的，另一边的；（在说话者、所指的人或物）对面的；（角）对的；（叶，芽）对生的
en: in a position facing something or someone but on the other side
ex: The bank is opposite the post office.

zh: n. 玫瑰，蔷薇
en: a flower with a pleasant smell and sharp points on the stem, that grow on a bush
ex: There's a lovely rose garden in the park.

zh: n. 湖，湖泊
en: a large area of water that has land all around it
ex: Chapultepec Park has a lake.

zh: 缆车，空中缆车；<美>有轨缆车（尤指旧金山等地的传统有轨缆车，常称叮当车）
en: a vehicle that hangs from thick cables and carries people up hills and mountains
ex: You can get there by cable car.

zh: 喷泉；喷射；天然泉；源泉；（纹章）银蓝相间波状纹圆盾
en: a structure that forces water up into the air as a decoration
ex: There are beautiful fountains in the park.

zh: 弥合（分歧），消除（隔阂）；兼具……的特点；在……上架桥，横跨
en: a structure that is built over a river, road, etc. so that people or vehicles can go across it
ex: Everyone knows the Golden Gate Bridge.

zh: to give food to a person, group, or animal
en: to give food to a person, group, or animal
ex: People feed the iguanas.
